title: A Cockroach Can Live for Days or Even Weeks Without Its Head

scenes.text: A cockroach can keep living after its head is gone.
It breathes through little holes along its body, not its mouth.
Its blood pressure is so low that the neck just clots shut.
Nerve clusters in each body segment handle reflexes. The body still moves.
It can go weeks without food, so it only dies when it cannot drink or eat.

description:
A cockroach can survive without its head for days, and by some accounts weeks.
It breathes through holes along its body, its blood pressure is so low that the neck clots shut, and nerve clusters in each segment control basic reflexes. It eventually dies because it cannot eat or drink.
What is the toughest bug you know of? Tell us.
first_comment: Cockroaches have been around for roughly 300 million years. What is the toughest animal you know?
